verdict.line: You lose if you facetank Aatrox's full Q swing sequence before your Fury is banked; you win if you hold engages until 50+ Fury and punish his W or E cooldown.

brief.thesis: Both champions are threshold-gated: Renekton needs 50+ Fury to turn Q, W, and E into their strong versions, and Aatrox needs his three-swing Q or a Umbral Dash reposition to land real damage. Whoever forces a trade on their own terms wins it; whoever gets baited into the other's cooldown window loses it. The 51.9% win rate over 1042 games reflects a genuinely even lane decided by execution, not itemization.

theirWindow.what: Don't overextend on minions or walk straight lines near him — the chain pull (825 range) punishes predictable positioning, and eating it into his Q swings is how you lose HP fast.

yourWindow.when: Your Fury is 50+ and W is off cooldown
yourWindow.what: Engage with empowered W (three slashes, strips shields, 1.5s stun), follow with E (Slice and Dice) and empowered Q for the full burst — this is your highest-damage trade window in the lane.

runes.keystoneWhy: Conqueror stacks through the extended trades this matchup produces and adds healing on top of your Q's built-in heal, letting you win prolonged fury-dump all-ins.

summoners.why: Run at 53.2% win rate and 92% pick rate; Ignite's grievous wounds directly counters Deathbringer Stance, Umbral Dash lifesteal, and R sustain, and secures kills during your Fury-dump all-in windows.

playing.title: Bank Fury before engaging
playing.detail: Only commit to a full trade once you're above 50 Fury — that's the difference between a single-slash W and a three-slash 1.5s stun that also strips shields.

playing.title: Don't stand in Q2/Q3
playing.detail: Aatrox's Q hits with up to three sequential swings in different areas; if he starts the animation, back out instead of trading through all three hits.

playing.title: Punish Infernal Chains cooldown
playing.detail: W is 20s at rank 1, dropping to 12s at max — once he uses it and misses or lands it, you have a long window to shove or all-in without pull threat.

playing.title: Trade after his Umbral Dash
playing.detail: Aatrox's E is a short-cooldown dash (9 down to 5s) he uses to poke and heal off you — if he just spent it, his mobility is down and your E (Slice and Dice) closes the gap for a free hit.

playing.title: Follow the QEWQQRQEQEREEWW order
playing.detail: E at level 2 gives you the dash to punish cooldowns immediately; W at level 3 turns on the stun lock that anchors every future trade.

playing.title: Buy Executioner's Calling on read
playing.detail: If Aatrox starts out-sustaining your damage through Deathbringer Stance and E healing, grievous wounds neutralizes it faster than trying to out-damage the heal.

playing.title: Save your R for his R
playing.detail: Both ultimates unlock at 6 with the same cooldown curve (120 down to 80s) — banking Fury before trading at level 6 means Dominus adds damage and tankiness right when his World Ender adds AD and sustain.

brief.patchCaveat: Build order, win rates, and pick rates are pulled from measured games on the current patch via OP.GG; the tactical read — Fury thresholds, cooldown-punish windows, and combo timing — is our own analysis, not measured data.

stats.opponentTip: Be careful of being hit with Aatrox’s (Q)-(E). Purchase Executioner’s Calling, and try engaging aggressively while building up Fury.
